offLimbContext.source: lens-specific pinned CR2311 Earth-facing SDO observation; transparent for continuum and magnetic lenses
offLimbContext.composition: source-disc-registered prepared off-limb pixels behind the retained Carrington sphere
offLimbContext.rotation: stationary observed context; never presented as rotating global material

limbMaterial.composition: body-registered lens-derived rim and continuum source-derived limb-darkening plate over visible retained leaves

controls.label: Photosphere
controls.qualification: NASA SDO/HMI CR2311 central-meridian continuum mosaic with source-derived limb normalization and qualified polar continuation
controls.notes: Colorized HMI continuum mosaic for Carrington Rotation 2311, 12 May–9 June 2026. It combines different observation dates; limb normalization and polar continuation are prepared display adjustments.

controls.label: Magnetic field
controls.qualification: False-colour NASA SDO/HMI CR2311 full-surface radial magnetic-field map
controls.notes: False-color HMI radial magnetic field for Carrington Rotation 2311, 12 May–9 June 2026. A synoptic mosaic, not a simultaneous photograph; weak and strong fields use a nonlinear color scale.

controls.label: Chromosphere
controls.qualification: NASA SDO AIA 304 angstrom CR2311 full-surface synoptic map
controls.notes: False-color AIA 304 Å synoptic mosaic, 12 May–9 June 2026. Missing samples use latitude continuation. The stationary off-limb image is a separate observation from 27 May 2026.

controls.label: Corona
controls.qualification: NASA SDO AIA 171 angstrom CR2311 full-surface synoptic map
controls.notes: False-color AIA 171 Å synoptic mosaic, 12 May–9 June 2026. Missing samples use latitude continuation. The stationary off-limb image is a separate observation from 27 May 2026.
